Title: System-assigned Managed Identity for Virtual Machines and Virtual Machine Scale Sets is now available

Body.Content:
Use a system assigned managed identity with a Virtual Machine and Virtual Machine Scale Sets. This enables your code to authenticate to other cloud services, without needing to store credentials in code. 

Learn more.
